title: Build the operator-facing report for a dependency-parked group
body:
## Context

Depends-on: #900 — this issue is the operator surface for the ordering edge, and must not be built before that one merges.

Split: true

The two land in different commits, so R1's union is overridden and they are TWO groups — the only shape where a cross-group ordering edge exists at all. Where R1 unions them they are one group, the edge is intra-group, and the queue correctly has nothing to enforce. An operator who wants work ordered but shipped separately writes exactly these two lines, and that is the case the queue used to get wrong.

## Deliverable

Two queue-level park reasons reach the operator with an action that is true for a group that never dispatched: `dependency-parked:#N` and `dependency-cycle`. Neither has a diff, a branch, or findings to review, so the generic fallback — "inspect the state file and re-run" — sends an operator looking for work that was never written.

## References

`extension/src/work-queue-cap.ts:60` holds the operator text; `extension/src/work-queue-render.ts:42` is where the two kinds of park must be visually distinguishable.
